verdict: Paid ads have been off since Aug 6; restart and intake repair are underway.
narrative: All 43 leads and $1,024 in ad spend this period were delivered before August 6 — Meta has had zero spend for 14 consecutive days, so no new paid leads have entered since then. Of those 43 leads, only 31 are recorded as contacts with no appointments created, which points to a gap in how incoming leads are being received and followed up on, not a performance problem with the ads themselves. Your Google Business Profile also saw a sharp drop in actions over the last 7 days, and both paid and organic social have been dark simultaneously, suggesting an account-level issue being actively investigated. Ads are being reactivated and the lead intake process is being tightened so that every new lead is captured and actioned when volume resumes.

cost per lead during the active ad window

watch_item.issue: Meta ads have been off since Aug 6 and Instagram reach has been zero for 13 days, stopping all incoming paid leads.
watch_item.fix: Ads are being reactivated this week, and the lead intake process is being repaired to ensure no contacts are lost when volume returns.
